rulebook.title: YCFA Official Rule Book (Season 1)
rulebook.intro: These rules apply to every member of the YCFA Discord server and every YCFA game. Cite rules by number, for example "Rule 4.3".

articles.title: League Basics and Authority
articles.body:
**1.1** The YCFA is a college football league played on NFL Universe Football (Ultimate Football) on Roblox. All official games are played in private servers.

**1.2** Season 1 has 18 teams in four conferences:
- **ACC:** Clemson, Florida State, Miami, Duke, North Carolina
- **SEC:** Alabama, Auburn, Florida, LSU
- **Big 12:** Kansas State, Houston, Texas Tech, Arizona, Utah
- **Big Ten:** Oregon, Michigan, Ohio State, USC

**1.3** The schedule includes conference and non-conference games, played one week at a time. Each week and its deadline is posted in #schedule🗓️.

**1.4** League authority runs from the Founder and Co-Founder through the Overseer, Commissioner and Co-Commissioner to the rest of staff. The Department of Justice (DOJ) handles discipline and appeals. Referees run games and submit stats.

**1.5** Staff may rule on any situation these rules do not cover. That ruling applies until the rule book is updated.

**1.6** Not knowing a rule is not an excuse.

articles.title: Teams, Rosters and Staff
articles.body:
**2.1** Each team is run by a Franchise Owner (FO), who may appoint one Head Coach, one General Manager and up to two Assistant Coaches. Team staff count toward the roster if they also play.

**2.2** Rosters hold a maximum of 18 players. A team must have at least 7 active players to remain in good standing.

**2.3** The FO is responsible for the team: keeping the roster current, arranging games on time, and making sure players follow these rules. The FO answers to league staff for the team's conduct.

**2.4** Head Coaches and GMs may sign, release and request transfers on behalf of the FO. Assistant Coaches may help arrange games but may not make roster moves.

**2.5** A player may be on one YCFA team only. Every player must have the correct team role; players without one may not play in official games.

**2.6** Alternate accounts are banned. Each person may use one Discord account and one Roblox account in the league. Using an alt to play, vote, evade a punishment or pose as another player results in a ban for every account involved.

**2.7** An FO who leaves the server or goes inactive for 7 days may be replaced by league staff.

articles.title: Transfers and Free Agency
articles.body:
**3.1** Each player has **2 transfers per season**, shown by the roles 2 TRANSFER, 1 TRANSFER and 0 TRANSFERS LEFT. A transfer is any move from one team to another, whether the player was released or requested a move.

**3.2** A player with 0 TRANSFERS LEFT may not join a new team for the rest of the season, except through a staff ruling.

**3.3** Players without a team hold the free agent role and may advertise in #free-agency💰.

**3.4** Every signing, release and transfer is posted in #transactions✍️ by the FO, Head Coach or GM, with the player's Discord mention and Roblox username. A move is official only once staff confirm it and roles are updated.

**3.5** The transfer and signing window closes at the deadline of Week 6. After that, rosters are locked except to replace a player who has left the server, with staff approval.

**3.6** A player signed during a week may play in that week's game only if the move was confirmed before kickoff.

**3.7** Tampering is banned. Team staff and players may not contact a player on another team about joining their team unless that player has first said publicly that they want to move or has opened a ticket asking to transfer. Offering Robux, items or other rewards to join a team is also tampering.

articles.title: Scheduling and Games
articles.body:
**4.1** Every game must be played before that week's deadline (for example, Week 1 deadline: 11/24/26, 10 PM EST). All times in this rule book are EST.

**4.2** Game times are arranged in #gametimes🕧. The home team (listed second in #schedule🗓️) proposes at least two times; the away team must accept one or propose others within 24 hours.

**4.3** If the teams cannot agree within 48 hours of the schedule being posted, either FO opens a ticket in #support🎫 and staff set the game time. That time is final.

**4.4** The home team hosts the private server and sends the link to the opposing FO and the referee at least 15 minutes before kickoff.

**4.5** Game settings: 7v7, four 5-minute quarters, default league rules, no mercy rule in game settings. Both teams must have at least 5 players to start.

**4.6** A team not ready 15 minutes after the agreed start time forfeits. A team that refuses to schedule or is unresponsive past the deadline also forfeits.

**4.7** A forfeit is recorded as a **21-0** loss. If neither team made a good-faith effort to play, both teams take a forfeit loss. Forfeit games produce no player stats.

**4.8** If a player disconnects, the referee pauses at the next dead ball for up to 5 minutes for a rejoin. Play then resumes with or without the player. If a team drops below 5 players for more than 10 minutes, the referee may end the game and staff decide the result.

**4.9** If the server crashes, the game resumes in a new server with the score, quarter, possession and time the referee recorded.

**4.10** There is no mercy rule. Once a team leads by 28 or more in the fourth quarter, the trailing team may concede with the referee's approval; the score stands as played.

**4.11** A reschedule past the deadline needs both FOs to agree and staff approval through a ticket before the deadline. Staff grant a reschedule at most once per team per season, unless the reason is a league-wide issue such as a Roblox outage.

articles.title: Gameplay Rules
articles.body:
**5.1** Exploits, scripts, executors and any third-party program that changes the game or gives an advantage are banned. Use of one is an automatic Strike 3 (Rule 8.3).

**5.2** Lag-switching or deliberately lowering your connection to gain an advantage is banned.

**5.3** Abusing known glitches is banned. This includes clipping through players or walls, ball-spawning or ball-duplication bugs, and any bug that freezes the clock, the ball or the opposing team.

**5.4** Griefing is banned: leaving or resetting on purpose to stop a play, blocking or kicking your own teammates, or disrupting the server in any way.

**5.5** Players must not go AFK during a live game. A player who is AFK for two straight plays may be replaced or removed by their team.

**5.6** Running clock with normal football plays (kneels, running the ball, using the full play clock) is legal. Using bugs or menus to stop the game from progressing is not.

**5.7** Only rostered players of the two teams, the referee and approved staff, streamers or content creators may be in the server. Unapproved spectators must leave when asked.

**5.8** If a rule break decides a game, staff may overturn the result or order a replay.

articles.title: Referees and Stats
articles.body:
**6.1** Every official game needs a YCFA referee. If no referee is available 30 minutes after the agreed time, either FO may open a ticket and staff will assign one or move the game.

**6.2** The referee confirms both rosters before kickoff, keeps the game moving, rules on disconnects and stoppages under Article 4, and reports rule breaks to staff.

**6.3** A referee may not referee a game involving their own team.

**6.4** After the game, the referee runs **/stats** with the final score, the week, and screenshots of every stats tab: PASSING, RECEIVING, RUSHING, D-LINE, CORNERBACK and SPECIAL.

**6.5** Screenshots must be real screenshots, not phone photos of a monitor. The PLAYER name column must be visible, and the tab must be scrolled so every row is shown, using more than one screenshot if needed.

**6.6** Stats must be submitted within 2 hours of the final whistle. Stats appear on https://ycfarblx.github.io within about a minute. Rankings use the points system explained on the site's "How PTS work" page.

**6.7** A stat correction or score dispute must be raised through a ticket in #support🎫 within **48 hours** of the game, with screenshots or clips. After 48 hours, stats are final.

**6.8** Faking, editing or holding back stats or screenshots is a Strike 3 offence for everyone involved.

articles.title: Conduct
articles.body:
**7.1** Treat every member, player and staff member with respect.

**7.2** Harassment, threats, slurs and hate speech of any kind are banned, in the server, DMs and in game.

**7.3** NSFW content, including images, links, names and avatars, is banned.

**7.4** Doxxing, or sharing anyone's personal information, is banned and results in a permanent ban.

**7.5** Spam, mass pinging and advertising other servers, leagues or products are banned without staff permission.

**7.6** Trash talk is allowed if it is about football. It becomes a violation once it targets someone's family, identity, appearance or real life, or continues after the person asks you to stop.

**7.7** Do not impersonate others or misuse tickets.

**7.8** Discipline issued in #suspensions🚨 may not be argued in public channels. Use Rule 8.6.

articles.title: Discipline
articles.body:
**8.1** Staff may give a verbal warning for minor first offences. Warnings are logged.

**8.2** Strikes are given for rule breaks and last the whole season. Suspensions are posted in #suspensions🚨 and the player receives the suspended role.

**8.3** Strike penalties:

| Strike | Penalty |
|---|---|
| Strike 1 | Written warning |
| Strike 2 | 1-game suspension |
| Strike 3 | 3-game suspension |
| Strike 4 | Removal from the league for the rest of the season |

Serious offences (Rules 2.6, 5.1, 6.8, 7.2, 7.4) may skip straight to Strike 3 or a permanent ban.

**8.4** A suspended player may not play, coach or make roster moves. A team that plays a suspended or ineligible player forfeits that game (Rule 4.7).

**8.5** Team penalties: a team with 2 forfeits in a season, or found tampering, may lose transfer rights, be stripped of wins, or have its FO removed by league staff.

**8.6** Any punishment may be appealed to the DOJ through a ticket in #support🎫 within **48 hours** of it being issued. The DOJ's decision is final. Suspensions remain in effect during the appeal.

articles.title: Standings, Awards and Season
articles.body:
**9.1** Standings are ranked by win percentage. Ties are broken in order by:
1. Conference record
2. Point differential
3. Head-to-head result (decided by staff)
4. Coin flip by staff

The live standings on the website and in #standings📊 apply steps 1 and 2 automatically.

**9.2** Forfeit results count in standings; the 21-0 score counts toward point differential.

**9.3** Player of the Week is announced each week in #potw🏆. Staff also track the Heisman race and league records on the website.

**9.4** The playoff format, seeding and championship schedule will be announced by league staff before the end of the regular season.

articles.title: Changes to the Rules
articles.body:
**10.1** League staff may add to or change these rules at any time.

**10.2** Every change is announced in #announcements📢 and takes effect when announced, unless the announcement states otherwise.

**10.3** Changes do not reverse results or punishments that were final before the change.
